sources.title: cardiffnlp/twitter-xlm-roberta-base-sentiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a multilingual XLM-roBERTa-base model trained on ~198M tweets and finetuned for sentiment analysis. The sentiment fine-tuning was done on 8 languages (Ar, En, Fr, De, Hi, It, Sp, Pt) but it can be used for more languages (see paper for details).

sources.snippet: XLM-T - A Multilingual Language Model Toolkit for Twitter As explained in the reference paper, we make start from XLM-Roberta base and continue pre-training on a large corpus of Twitter in multiple languages. This masked language model, which we named twitter-xlm-roberta-base in the 🤗Huggingface hub, can be downloaded from here.

sources.title: Base Model: twitter-xlm-roberta-base | cardiffnlp/xlm-t | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The twitter-xlm-roberta-base model has a hidden size of 768. This refers to the dimensionality of the hidden states in the transformer layers, which is a standard size for base-level transformer models. Hugging Face Hub Identifiers The model is publicly available on the Hugging Face Hub under the identifier cardiffnlp/twitter-xlm-roberta-base.

sources.title: XLM-RoBERTa Base: Multilingual Transformer Model by Facebook AI
sources.snippet: XLM-RoBERTa (XLM-R) is a state-of-the-art multilingual transformer model supporting 100 languages. Pre-trained on 2.5TB of data, it excels at cross-lingual transfer for tasks like classification, NER, and QA. Available under MIT license.
